papers.title: Graph Neural Reinforcement Learning for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling
papers.abstract: We study flexible job shop scheduling with graph neural networks and reinforcement learning. A learned dispatching rule assigns operations to machines to minimize makespan while respecting precedence and machine capacity constraints. We compare solution quality and runtime on held-out scheduling instances.

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Constrained Multi-Objective Evolutionary Optimization
papers.abstract: We present an evolutionary algorithm for constrained multi-objective optimization. Deep reinforcement learning adapts operator selection and search resources. The memetic algorithm balances feasibility and objective quality through local search and knowledge transfer.

papers.title: Large Language Model Agents for Automatic Mixed-Integer Programming
papers.abstract: We study operations research and mixed-integer programming with large language model multi-agent systems. Agents translate resource allocation specifications into constraints and objectives, use a solver to check feasibility, and repair modeling errors with tool feedback.
